entities.name: Daria

entities.description: Recruited Daria into the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Nine Titans

entities.description: Adopted and apprenticed Daria after he was reborn.

entities.description: Persuaded to ascend with Daria's help.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat

events.summary: Daria is abandoned by her parents, who feared her powers, and is adopted by Taysir.

events.summary: Daria helps convince Jared Carthalion to ascend.
